701.en: She joined a student organization that protects the environment.
701.zh: 她加入了一个保护环境的学生组织。

702.en: The essay needs a clearer structure with linked paragraphs.
702.zh: 这篇文章需要更清晰的结构和衔接的段落。

703.en: The city's underground system carries millions of passengers daily.
703.zh: 这座城市的地铁系统每天运送数百万乘客。

704.en: This method of teaching relies heavily on group work.
704.zh: 这种教学方法主要依靠小组合作。

705.en: The professor takes a practical approach to teaching grammar.
705.zh: 这位教授采用实用的方法教语法。

706.en: Their marketing strategy targets university students.
706.zh: 他们的营销策略以大学生为目标。

707.en: The potter demonstrated an ancient glazing technique.
707.zh: 陶艺师演示了一种古老的上釉技术。

708.en: Follow the standard procedure when reporting an accident.
708.zh: 报告事故时请遵循标准程序。

709.en: The application process takes about four weeks.
709.zh: 申请过程大约需要四周。

710.en: My tutor was pleased with the progress I had made.
710.zh: 导师对我取得的进步很满意。

711.en: The development of the port brought jobs to the town.
711.zh: 港口的发展给小镇带来了就业机会。

712.en: There has been a clear improvement in her pronunciation.
712.zh: 她的发音有了明显的进步。

713.en: The advancement of medical technology has extended human life.
713.zh: 医疗技术的进步延长了人类的寿命。

714.en: The museum traces the evolution of the bicycle.
714.zh: 博物馆展示了自行车的演变历程。

715.en: The industrial revolution completely changed working life.
715.zh: 工业革命彻底改变了劳动生活。

716.en: The old harbour has undergone a complete transformation.
716.zh: 旧港口经历了彻底的改造。

717.en: There has been a change in the timetable for next week.

718.en: The plan needs only a small modification before approval.
718.zh: 这个方案只需稍作修改即可获批。

719.en: Moving abroad requires a period of adjustment.
719.zh: 移居国外需要一段适应期。

720.en: The camel's adaptation to desert life is remarkable.
720.zh: 骆驼对沙漠生活的适应能力令人惊叹。

721.en: Online courses give students greater flexibility.
721.zh: 在线课程给学生更大的灵活性。

722.zh: 政治稳定吸引外国投资。

723.en: It is hard to keep a balance between study and part-time work.
723.zh: 在学习和兼职之间保持平衡很难。

724.en: The design blends in harmony with the surrounding landscape.
724.zh: 这个设计与周围景观和谐相融。

725.en: There is often a conflict between development and conservation.
725.zh: 发展与保护之间常常存在冲突。

726.en: You could feel the tension in the room before the results were announced.
726.zh: 结果公布前，房间里的紧张气氛显而易见。

727.en: Students often feel under pressure to get high grades.
727.zh: 学生常常感到取得高分的压力。

728.en: Listening to music helps me deal with stress.
728.zh: 听音乐帮助我缓解压力。

729.en: Deep breathing can reduce anxiety before an exam.
729.zh: 深呼吸可以减轻考前焦虑。

730.en: There is no need to worry about the interview.

731.en: The main concern of parents is their children's safety online.
731.zh: 家长最关注的是孩子的网络安全。

732.en: Elderly patients need extra care and patience.
732.zh: 老年病人需要额外的照顾和耐心。

733.en: Loud noise outside drew the students' attention away from the lecture.
733.zh: 外面的噪音分散了学生们听课的注意力。

734.en: Try to focus on one task at a time.
734.zh: 尽量一次专注于一项任务。

735.en: Lack of sleep affects memory and concentration.
735.zh: 睡眠不足会影响记忆力和注意力。

736.en: Her dedication to teaching earned her a national award.
736.zh: 她对教学的奉献为她赢得了国家级奖项。

737.en: Learning an instrument requires long-term commitment.
737.zh: 学习乐器需要长期的投入。

738.en: His devotion to the research project impressed his colleagues.
738.zh: 他对研究项目的专注令同事们钦佩。

739.en: The airline rewards customer loyalty with free flights.
739.zh: 这家航空公司用免费机票回馈忠实顾客。

740.en: Honesty is essential in academic writing.
740.zh: 诚实在学术写作中至关重要。

741.en: The judge was respected for her integrity.
741.zh: 这位法官因正直而受到尊敬。

742.en: The novel raises questions about science and morality.
742.zh: 这部小说提出了关于科学与道德的问题。

743.en: Medical research must follow strict ethics guidelines.
743.zh: 医学研究必须遵循严格的伦理准则。

744.en: Treating everyone fairly is a basic principle of the school.
744.zh: 公平对待每个人是这所学校的基本原则。

745.en: The training course offers good value for money.
745.zh: 这门培训课程物有所值。

746.en: The teacher stressed the importance of regular revision.
746.zh: 老师强调了定期复习的重要性。

747.en: The discovery is of great significance for cancer research.
747.zh: 这一发现对癌症研究具有重大意义。

748.en: The meaning of the word depends on its context.
748.zh: 这个词的含义取决于上下文。

749.en: The purpose of the survey is to improve campus services.
749.zh: 这项调查的目的是改进校园服务。

750.en: Her goal is to get a band seven in IELTS.
750.zh: 她的目标是雅思考到七分。

751.en: The main objective of the workshop is to improve writing skills.
751.zh: 工作坊的主要目标是提高写作能力。

752.en: The charity set a target of raising fifty thousand pounds.
752.zh: 慈善机构设定了筹款五万英镑的目标。

753.en: His ambition is to open his own restaurant one day.
753.zh: 他的抱负是有朝一日开一家自己的餐厅。

754.en: Many young people share the aspiration to study abroad.
754.zh: 许多年轻人都怀有出国留学的愿望。

755.en: She had a strong desire to see the world.
755.zh: 她强烈渴望去看看世界。

756.en: It is my wish to return to my hometown after graduation.
756.zh: 我希望毕业后回到家乡。

757.en: There is still hope that the missing paintings will be found.
757.zh: 找回失踪画作仍有希望。

758.en: The film did not live up to my expectation.
758.zh: 这部电影没有达到我的期望。

759.en: The students waited in anticipation for their results.
759.zh: 学生们满怀期待地等待成绩。

760.en: The prediction of earthquakes remains extremely difficult.
760.zh: 地震预测仍然极其困难。

761.en: The weather forecast says it will be sunny all weekend.
761.zh: 天气预报说整个周末都是晴天。

762.en: This is only a rough estimation of the total cost.
762.zh: 这只是对总成本的粗略估计。

763.en: A small error in the calculation changed the whole result.
763.zh: 计算中的一个小错误改变了整个结果。

764.en: Accurate measurement is essential in any experiment.
764.zh: 准确的测量在任何实验中都至关重要。

765.en: A large quantity of plastic waste ends up in the sea.
765.zh: 大量塑料垃圾最终流入海洋。

766.en: A certain amount of stress is normal before exams.
766.zh: 考前有一定程度的压力是正常的。

767.en: The number of overseas students has risen sharply.
767.zh: 海外学生的数量急剧上升。

768.en: The latest sales figures show a steady increase.
768.zh: 最新的销售数字显示稳步增长。

769.en: This statistic shows how quickly the city is growing.
769.zh: 这一统计数字显示了这座城市发展的速度。

770.en: The data was collected from over two thousand households.
770.zh: 这些数据是从两千多户家庭收集来的。

771.en: More information about the course is available online.
771.zh: 关于这门课程的更多信息可在网上查询。

772.en: Please check every detail before submitting the form.
772.zh: 提交表格前请核对每一个细节。

773.en: Pay particular attention to the spelling of names.
773.zh: 请特别注意姓名的拼写。

774.en: The teacher gave specific instructions for the assignment.
774.zh: 老师对作业给出了具体的要求。

775.en: Please give the precise time of your arrival.
775.zh: 请提供你到达的精确时间。

776.en: Nobody knows the exact age of the ancient monument.
776.zh: 没有人知道这座古代遗迹的确切年代。

777.en: Make sure your references are accurate and complete.
777.zh: 确保你的参考文献准确完整。

778.en: Choose the correct answer from the four options.
778.zh: 从四个选项中选出正确答案。

779.en: Turn right at the traffic lights and the bank is on your left.
779.zh: 在红绿灯处右转，银行就在你左手边。

780.en: Please wear proper safety equipment in the workshop.
780.zh: 在车间里请穿戴适当的安全装备。

781.en: Jeans are not appropriate for a formal interview.
781.zh: 牛仔裤不适合正式面试的场合。

782.en: The film is suitable for children of all ages.
782.zh: 这部电影适合所有年龄段的儿童观看。

783.en: Regular jogging keeps him fit and energetic.
783.zh: 经常慢跑使他保持健康和活力。

784.en: Match each speaker with the correct opinion.
784.zh: 将每位说话者与正确的观点配对。

785.en: The written figures should correspond with the totals in the table.
785.zh: 书面数字应与表格中的总数相对应。

786.en: The second lecture relates closely to the first one.
786.zh: 第二场讲座与第一场紧密相关。

787.en: A new bridge will connect the island to the mainland.
787.zh: 一座新桥将把岛屿与大陆连接起来。

788.en: Studies link regular exercise to better mental health.
788.zh: 研究表明经常锻炼与更好的心理健康有关联。

789.en: Please attach a recent photo to your application.
789.zh: 请在申请表上附上一张近照。

790.en: You can join the film club at the freshers' fair.
790.zh: 你可以在迎新会上加入电影社。

791.en: The course combines classroom study with work experience.
791.zh: 这门课程将课堂学习与工作实践相结合。

792.en: The two small colleges will merge into one next year.
792.zh: 这两所小型学院明年将合并为一所。

793.en: The campaign united students from different departments.
793.zh: 这次活动把不同院系的学生联合了起来。

794.en: The new software integrates all the library services.
794.zh: 新软件整合了图书馆的所有服务。

795.en: The final design incorporates suggestions from residents.
795.zh: 最终设计纳入了居民的建议。

796.en: The course fees include all books and materials.
796.zh: 课程费用包括所有书籍和材料。

797.en: Some energy drinks contain a lot of caffeine.
797.zh: 有些能量饮料含有大量咖啡因。

798.en: The exam comprises four papers: listening, reading, writing and speaking.
798.zh: 考试由听、读、写、说四部分组成。

799.en: The committee consists of two teachers and five students.
799.zh: 委员会由两名教师和五名学生组成。

800.en: Women compose about sixty percent of the workforce here.
800.zh: 这里的员工大约百分之六十由女性组成。
